title: Drop checklists entirely
description: Please note that similar changes will have to be done for devel-release/*.yaml template - I haven't done them yet because I'd like to ensure this is how we want to do it and then copy the same to devel-release/* templates thereafter.
commit_message:
Drop checklists entirely

We've been bitten by this a bit too much - it's time to
completely drop this entirely now and move the checklist
items to the description instead.
